spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mature lettuce Crop
spec.description: A rooted butterhead lettuce with spreading, scalloped outer leaves, airy lifted middle leaves and a tightly cupped pale heart. Stepped leaf lobes and painted branching veins create a recognizable edible rosette without a pot or soil.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. A mature planted lettuce crop with botanically recognizable growth: appropriate leaves/stems, ripe edible parts and realistic species-specific plant silhouette in Minecraft cuboids. Airy gaps, layered leaf shapes, leaf veins, natural plant clusters. NOT a generic tomato bush recolored. Rooted at y0, x2..14,z2..14,y0..16. No pot or dirt block. All growth-stage variants will be based on this model.
